description:
Questions answered in this Q & A program are:
- As Seventh-day Adventist we are historicists in Bible interpretations, so why do you have some cases where you have flashbacks, and not strictly in the chronological order?
- When were those who resurrected with Jesus presented to the Father? On resurrection morning or 40-days later?
- In 1898 Ellen G. White had said that Christ's deity had suffered and sank under the agonies of Calgary. Then she wrote that it didn't sink and die. Please explain this contradiction.
- How do we consider the resurrection of Christ to be proof of His divinity, if other individuals were resurrected as well. Were they God?
- If Jesus is our High Priest and he has to purify the sanctuary in Heaven, are there sins in the sanctuary as it was in the earthly sanctuary?
